newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss private bank ups 96 profits 4.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss private bank ups 96 profits 4.3 pct.

text.p: Union Bancaire Privee, a Geneva-based Swiss private bank, reported a 4.3 percent rise in 1996 net profits to 161.3 million Swiss francs compared to the previous year.
The bank's annual report said consolidated balance sheet assets rose 6.1 percent over 1995 to 13.4 billion Swiss francs.
Consolidated income rose 11 percent to 449 million Swiss francs against a 23.9 percent jump in consolidated expenses to 205.7 million Swiss francs.
The bank's annual report provided only scanty information on its core private banking activities.
But it gave a geographic breakdown of client assets.

European clients accounted for 79.2 percent of total assets managed by the bank with some 10.6 billion Swiss francs, followed by North American clients, who had a 10.8 percent share with 1.4 billion Swiss francs.
